Continue toward a hover centered over the holder, keeping the gripper open and maintaining configuration continuity.

Allow the released coin to settle into the slot, keep the jaws open, and withdraw vertically a short distance before returning home.

Continue the open-gripper return away from the bank, gradually unwinding the wrist and preserving the elbow-up configuration.
Return the right arm toward its original height and position in small continuous steps; the gripper remains open and clear of the bank.
Continue the gradual return to origin, reducing the right wrist tilt as the arm retracts. Keep both grippers open.
